initial_condition: q0=(0,0); v0=A*omega1*(1,r1); a0 restored by actual production consistent acceleration initialization
section_axis_convention: Iy=width*height^3/12, Iz=height*width^3/12; global-Y bending uses Iz
physical_mass_model: linear N1,N2 translation and spatial-spin interpolation, two-point Gauss; root-fixed planar block M=diag(rho*A*L/3,rho*Iz*L/3)
stiffness_model: Euler-Bernoulli small-local-strain corotational, exact zero-state block K=E*Iz*[[12/L^3,-6/L^2],[-6/L^2,4/L]]
damping_model: actual production automatic full-structure modal Rayleigh, translation reference modes 1 and 2, both target zeta=.02; no injected explicit C
scope: New independently specified semidiscrete micro-amplitude bending problem derived from public straight-beam theory; not a reproduction of Aster's original mesh, Hermite mass, loading or transient golden table. No large-rotation claim. Spatial continuum convergence and higher-mode accuracy are separate.
